title: Two marks can update a range
hook: An interval update can be represented by where it starts and stops.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Apply an interval increment with difference-array endpoints then reconstruct values.

misconception: Increasing a long range requires touching each member immediately.
objective: Apply an interval increment with difference-array endpoints then reconstruct values.

claims.text: The increment starts at the left endpoint and is canceled just after the right endpoint. Prefix reconstruction carries that change through the interval, so updating two differences changes many values.
